item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "bea90ece7e23ccbc8d00cbcc153a31969fba817dddfd5331195fef938c7950d7",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "A predicate on coefficient records requiring discrim(timeTime, timeSpace, spaceSpace) > 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines the entire asserted hyperbolicity condition as strict positivity of the quadratic discriminant.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "Maps a real c to the coefficient record with timeTime = 1, timeSpace = 0, and spaceSpace = -(c^2).",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the record (1, 0, -(sqrt(bulkModulus / density))^2) to the hyperbolicity predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "The coefficient-record type used by the supplied constructor, record expression, and three coordinate projections.",
      "effect_on_target": "Packages the three real coefficients tested by the discriminant predicate; the target does not quantify over arbitrary records.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "A constructor taking three real coordinates and producing a LocalDef003 record.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports construction of the particular three-coefficient object in LocalDef002.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "Returns the third coordinate of the coefficient record.",
      "effect_on_target": "Extracts the spaceSpace coefficient, which is -(sqrt(bulkModulus / density))^2.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "LocalDef006",
      "meaning": "Returns the second coordinate of the coefficient record.",
      "effect_on_target": "Extracts the timeSpace coefficient, which is zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "LocalDef007",
      "meaning": "Returns the first coordinate of the coefficient record.",
      "effect_on_target": "Extracts the timeTime coefficient, which is one.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "DivInvMonoid.toDiv",
      "meaning": "Extracts the division operation from a division-with-inverse monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real division for bulkModulus / density.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "HDiv.hDiv",
      "meaning": "Extracts and applies the binary operation supplied by a heterogeneous division instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Evaluates the quotient of the two real parameters.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "LT.lt",
      "meaning": "Extracts the strict comparison relation from an LT instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses strict positivity in both hypotheses and the discriminant conclusion.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number numeral in the type specified by its OfNat instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Gives the typed numeric constants appearing in the hypotheses and coefficient computations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The type of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both universally quantified parameters and all coefficient and discriminant values are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Real.instDivInvMonoid",
      "meaning": "The real multiplicative structure with inversion and division, with division equal to multiplication by the inverse.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the real quotient used as the square-root argument.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "Real.instLT",
      "meaning": "Provides the strict order relation on real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes all positivity conditions ordinary strict real inequalities.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "Provides the real number zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the positivity threshold and the zero middle coefficient.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Real.sqrt",
      "meaning": "Converts a real to a nonnegative real, takes its nonnegative square root, and converts back to a real; equivalently, it is sqrt(max(x, 0)).",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects the nonnegative square root of bulkModulus / density. The hypotheses make this argument strictly positive.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets the numeral 0 using the supplied Zero instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures that the explicit zero literals denote real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "instHDiv",
      "meaning": "Turns a division operation on one type into heterogeneous-division notation with the same input and output type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the quotient notation to real division without changing its meaning.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "HPow.hPow",
      "meaning": "Extracts and applies the exponentiation operation from an HPow instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses squaring in the negative final coefficient and in the discriminant formula.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "Monoid.toNatPow",
      "meaning": "Supplies natural-number exponentiation from a monoid's iterated multiplication operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the exponent 2 denote ordinary multiplicative squaring.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "Nat",
      "meaning": "The type of natural numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the exponent type and numeral indices; no natural-number variable is quantified in the proposition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "Neg.neg",
      "meaning": "Extracts and applies the unary negation operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Negates the square in the spaceSpace coefficient.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "One.toOfNat1",
      "meaning": "Interprets the numeral 1 using the supplied One instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the unit timeTime coefficient.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "Real.instMonoid",
      "meaning": "Provides the multiplicative monoid structure on the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports real multiplication, its identity, and natural powers used in the coefficient construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "Real.instNeg",
      "meaning": "Provides real additive negation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the final coefficient the additive inverse of the squared square root.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "Real.instOne",
      "meaning": "Provides the real multiplicative identity one.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the first coefficient at real one.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "Real.instRing",
      "meaning": "Provides the ring structure on the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Instantiates the discriminant's arithmetic over the reals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "discrim",
      "meaning": "For ring elements a, b, and c, returns b^2 - 4*a*c.",
      "effect_on_target": "Turns hyperbolicity into 0 < 0^2 - 4*1*(-(sqrt(bulkModulus / density))^2), which simplifies under the hypotheses to 0 < 4*bulkModulus/density.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "instHPow",
      "meaning": "Turns an ordinary power operation into heterogeneous-power notation with the same base and result type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects power notation to real natural-number exponentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "instOfNatNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number numeral as that same natural number.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the exponent literal 2 the natural number two.",
      "status": "understood"
    }
  ],
  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "For every real number bulkModulus and every real number density.",
      "The explicit binders hbulkModulus and hdensity are proofs of the two positivity assumptions, not additional mathematical parameters."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [
      "bulkModulus > 0.",
      "density > 0."
    ],
    "conclusions": [
      "The coefficient record (timeTime, timeSpace, spaceSpace) = (1, 0, -(sqrt(bulkModulus / density))^2) has strictly positive quadratic discriminant.",
      "Explicitly, 0 < 0^2 - 4*1*(-(sqrt(bulkModulus / density))^2). Under the hypotheses, this is equivalently 0 < 4*(bulkModulus / density)."
    ],
    "mathematical_definitions": [
      "The coefficient object stores three real values named timeTime, timeSpace, and spaceSpace.",
      "For a real parameter s, LocalDef002(s) is the record (1, 0, -(s^2)).",
      "For a coefficient record (a, b, d), the predicate called IsHyperbolic means precisely b^2 - 4*a*d > 0.",
      "Real.sqrt(x) is the nonnegative square root of max(x, 0); here its argument is positive."
    ],
    "proposition_plain_english": "For all strictly positive real numbers bulkModulus and density, set s = sqrt(bulkModulus / density). Then the three-coefficient record (1, 0, -s^2) is hyperbolic in the precise sense that its quadratic discriminant 0^2 - 4*1*(-s^2) is strictly positive. This discriminant equals 4*bulkModulus/density. The parameter s and the record are explicitly determined by the two universally quantified inputs; there are no existential witnesses or additional conjunctive requirements."
  },
  "restrictions_and_vacuity_risks": [
    "The claim applies only when both real parameters are strictly positive; parameter pairs failing either assumption yield a vacuous implication.",
    "The admissible domain is nonempty, for example bulkModulus = density = 1, so the claim is not globally vacuous.",
    "Positive density excludes division by zero, and the positive quotient excludes the truncated negative-input branch of Real.sqrt.",
    "Strict positivity of the discriminant excludes the zero-discriminant case; no assertion is made about zero or negative parameter values.",
    "The parameter names do not impose physical units, constitutive laws, or any interpretation beyond two real numbers.",
    "The proposition concerns a coefficient record and its discriminant. It does not encode a differential equation, independent variables, a solution, regularity, initial or boundary data, or a well-posedness result.",
    "The exact discriminant convention is b^2 - 4*a*d. No correspondence between the middle coefficient and a mixed-derivative normalization is specified."
  ],
  "ambiguities": []
}
